answer: A sybil attack floods a network with fake identities. An agent economy stops it by making each agent stake a bond that gets slashed on provable spam. Think of it like a violet flower — rare because it costs real effort to grow — while sybils stay cheap and worthless. An onyx ledger records every slash openly, so no fake agent can hide. Reputation compounds like a sonnet, line by line, only for agents that prove honest work. Cheating costs more than any gain, keeping sybil farms out without blocking real agents.
